groups.description: No Crossref/PubMed record meets the identity rule (title/author/year/venue/coordinates).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Needs a new source (local PDF, publisher page, catalogue) or human sign-off.

groups.description: The citation byline has detail the identified source lacks (full given names, extra initials, accents, letters a registry could not encode, protected capitals).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Keep the citation byline; accept these bylines by batch after a 10-entry PDF/publisher spot-check.

groups.description: Unresolved @incollection entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: Unresolved @book entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: More than two fields differ from the identified record (single-source rule forbids a proposal).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Human review; batch by journal/decade; often wrong candidate or a heavily garbled citation.

groups.description: Author counts differ between the citation and the source record (missing authors, 'others', or a sparse registry byline).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Needs a document: batch-check against publisher pages/PDFs; accept source byline where it is complete.

groups.description: Crossref and PubMed give different values for the field that differs from the citation.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Human check against the publisher page/PDF; batch by field.

groups.description: Unresolved @inproceedings entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: The cited work's own DOI carries an erratum/correction notice (no retractions found). Metadata otherwise matches or differs only as listed in the plan's classes A/B/C.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Acknowledge as content-only errata in one batch after skimming the notice list; C-class rows (substantive discrepancy) individually.

groups.description: One or two fields differ but the source value is unusable or the sources disagree (e.g., no numeric issue, markup in title, Crossref and PubMed differ).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Human review by sub-pattern (see 'detail' counts).

groups.description: The identified record has a version/update relationship (preprint link, has-review, correction) that the resolver does not clear.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: One policy decision per relation type (e.g., accept journal version despite preprint link).

groups.description: Venue differs by a section/subtitle or a later renamed title; Crossref carries the current title and PubMed does not confirm a different venue.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Decide per journal family (e.g. QJEP Section A, EEG/Evoked Potentials, JRSS series); ~10 decisions.

groups.description: Unresolved @misc entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: Unresolved @inbook entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: Publisher JATS and PubMed agree on the cited DOI's volume/pages/article number, the citation differs, and no automatic route applies (sources disagree, second field, or preprint link).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Review as one packet; most need the coordinate fix plus one more field.

groups.description: The citation has an issue number the identified source does not give (and cannot be taken from the source).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Policy: keep or drop an unconfirmed issue number (one batch decision).

groups.description: Title differs from the source only in punctuation/quote style.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Accept the citation's typography (batch).

groups.description: Two or more distinct records fit the citation about equally well.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Human choice of record; usually quick.

groups.description: The identified record is not a journal article (book chapter, proceedings, posted content).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Batch: convert entry type or accept as-is per type.

groups.description: Unresolved @conference entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: The entry carries a field with no deterministic verifier (address, month, note, url, ...).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Policy: drop or keep the unverifiable field for the batch (recommend drop for @article).

groups.description: Year blocked by online-first dates: Crossref online and print years differ and the issued (earliest) date is the online year.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Policy: the print year wins. Accept citations already using the print year; correct those citing the online year (batch).

groups.description: DOI-linked PubMed has 'Jr' for an author and the citation lacks it; a second fix is also needed.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Accept 'add Jr from PubMed' for the batch; the second fix follows its own group.

groups.description: A source-backed fix exists but the edited entry still would not verify (remaining flag or rival).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Human review; mostly notices or rivals.

groups.description: Unresolved @techreport entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: Cited year is absent from, or conflicts with, the source dates (off by one or more).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Individual/document check; often a reprint or wrong year.

groups.description: A source-backed proposal exists, but an earlier documented audit held this key (verification/**/*audit-exclusions.json: e.g. would discard names, duplicate work).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Keep held; resolve with the documented evidence (PDF/byline) individually.

groups.description: Unresolved @phdthesis entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: Other article cases.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Individual review.

groups.description: Entry carries attached external evidence that needs explicit adjudication.
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Individual review of the attached evidence.

groups.description: Unresolved @manual entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.

groups.description: Unresolved @mastersthesis entries (non-article).
groups.suggested_batch_decision: Route to the books/proceedings plans; batch by sub-pattern.
